Maya: Quick sync 1: need final redirect and schema plan for the June webinar funnel. Goal: clean signals to SDRs and keep search intent grouped.
Noah: I'll own redirects. Proposed shortlinks: /r/webinar-jun -> /webinars/jun-2026-launch (301). Avoid chaining.
Rae: Keywords: 'llm serving cost', 'low-latency inference', 'redwood inference benchmark'. We'll map each to a landing section and ensure internal links from docs.
Maya: Can we add Event JSON-LD with speakers and register url? Short snippet pls.
Rae: Snippet: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch","startDate":"2026-06-10T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/jun-2026/register"}
Noah: nginx rule ready: rewrite ^/r/webinar-jun$ /webinars/jun-2026-launch permanent;
DevOps: Will deploy 301s tonight to avoid cache issues.
Maya: SEO Bot, run redirect-audit and flag any canonical mismatches? @SEO Bot
SEO Bot: queued audit-1792109876. Results in ~5m :mag:
Noah: Also adding internal link from /docs/kv-cache -> webinar landing with anchor 'benchmark webinar'
Maya: Thanks team. Action: Noah deploy redirects; Rae add JSON-LD to CMS; DevOps add canonical header. I'll QA post-deploy.
